notes:
Summary: Mariner is a mid-enterprise ecommerce platform (2.3M SKUs, multi-tenant catalog) looking to replace a brittle ES + in-house reranker. Primary goal = better semantic search relevance with predictable cost-per-query and ability to withstand 6-8x Black Friday traffic spikes. Evaluation currently focused on embeddings scale, reranking latency, and unit economics.

Requirements (client language / paraphrase):
- "Need first-page relevance lift without 10x cost increase" — strong cost sensitivity. Target blended cost-per-query: $0.0015 - $0.003 (including vector lookup + reranker).
- Indexing scale: ~2.3M SKUs, each with title, 2 descriptions, 8 attributes. Expect ~50-150 token average. Update cadence: full feed nightly, incremental hourly for price/stock.
- Targets: p95 end-to-end search latency < 250ms (target 150-200ms); p99 < 400ms during normal traffic, acceptable up to 600ms during peak if graceful degradation applied.
- Reranking profile: bi-encoder candidate generation + cross-encoder rerank for top-100. Cross-encoder must be small/quantized to keep cost down; fallback to cached scores for frequent queries.
- Traffic profile: steady baseline ~350 qps, seasonal peak (BF/Cyber) up to 2800 qps sustained for 48-72 hrs. Autoscale and burst capacity required.
- Ops & compliance: VPC deployment for catalog sensitive metadata, SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory, audit logs and KMS integration for embeddings at rest, EU data residency for EU customers.

POC asks: ingest 1M canonical SKUs, provide embedding storage + retrieval latency numbers, run reranker A/B against current in-house reranker on 50k sample queries, show cost-per-query breakdown (tokens, qps, storage, egress). They want a simulation of 6x load to demonstrate autoscaling and SLOs.

Quoted notes from Discovery call (02/12):
- "If we can get similar precision with 30-40% lower rerank cost vs our cross-encoder today, we move."
- "Cache hits on high-frequency queries are our single biggest ops lever."

Technical preferences and openness:
- Prefer open models or quantized variants (Llama2-7B/3B family or in-house 2B). Willing to consider Redwood-verified smaller reranker for cross-encoder stage.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization profile) to hit cost targets.

Risk/Concerns called out:
- Legal: EU residency controls in contract; cannot allow embeddings to leave EU for EU customers.
- Cost modeling: procurement wants a deterministic cost model for budgeting — not purely per-token spikes.
- Complexity: integration effort with search layer (they use custom service on top of ES + Redis).

Stubs/links: security questionnaire submitted (drive link above), Fireflies transcripts for intro/arch, Jira tickets for POC infra and security scoping (JIRA-POC-78, JIRA-SEC-1023).

Sales posture notes: keep pressure on cost-per-query proofs — run explicit "per-query invoice" style example in POC deck. Show fallback behavior (cached rerank scores, prefix caching) and routing policy for cross-region capacity exhaustion. Emphasize Dedicated/Dedicated+VPC as path to satisfy residency + burst SLAs.

Next meetings: mid-POC metrics review (wk of 2026-03-10), legal SOW sync (2026-03-24).
